findings.label: Inline cursor style in MediaUploader
findings.description: Line 159 uses style={{ cursor: ... }} for grab/grabbing states. Replace with Tailwind cursor-grab and cursor-grabbing utilities or a CSS class.

findings.label: Custom CSS for safe-area insets
findings.description: index.css contains @supports blocks for .pb-safe and .safe-area-inset-bottom. While necessary for notched device support, this is custom CSS outside Tailwind. Document as intentional exception or migrate to Tailwind plugin.

files.issue: Custom CSS for safe-area padding (intentional but worth documenting)
